news.headline: Nektar Announces Publication in The Lancet of Positive Phase 2b REZOLVE-AD 16-Week Induction Results of Rezpegaldesleukin in Moderate-to-Severe Atopic Dermatitis
news.summary: Nektar announced peer-reviewed publication in The Lancet of full 16-week induction results from the Phase 2b REZOLVE-AD study, confirming rezpegaldesleukin met all primary and key secondary endpoints (EASI-75/90, Itch NRS, vIGA-AD, BSA). The paper is described as the first large placebo-controlled trial validating Treg modulation as a clinical mechanism for chronic inflammatory disease.

news.headline: Piper Sandler Reaffirms Buy Rating on Nektar Therapeutics (NKTR)
news.summary: Following Q2 earnings, Piper Sandler analyst Yasmeen Rahimi reiterated her Buy/Overweight rating on Nektar, citing the strong cash runway and rezpegaldesleukin momentum from the newly launched Phase 3 program.

news.headline: JPMorgan Reinstates Coverage on Nektar Therapeutics at Neutral
news.summary: JPMorgan reinstated equity research coverage of Nektar with a Neutral rating as part of a broader reinstatement across its US large-cap biotech coverage list, contrasting with more bullish Buy calls from Canaccord and Piper Sandler.

news.headline: Nektar Therapeutics Announces Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results
news.summary: Nektar reported Q2 revenue of $10.1M (slightly below the $10.4M consensus) and a net loss of $40.6M, with cash and investments of $1.02B (up from $245.8M at year-end 2025) that management said funds operations into Q3 2028, past the mid-2028 ZENITH AD Phase 3 readout.

news.headline: Nektar Therapeutics Coverage Initiated at Canaccord Genuity Group
news.summary: Canaccord Genuity analyst Edward Nash initiated coverage of Nektar with a Buy rating and $153 price target, pointing to the newly launched Phase 3 rezpegaldesleukin program in atopic dermatitis.

news.headline: Nektar Therapeutics Announces Start of Phase 3 ZENITH AD Program Evaluating Novel Regulatory T-Cell Biologic Rezpegaldesleukin in Moderate-to-Severe Atopic Dermatitis
news.summary: Nektar began dosing patients in ZENITH AD-1 and ZENITH AD-2, twin global registrational Phase 3 trials of rezpegaldesleukin (two 510-patient studies) in moderate-to-severe atopic dermatitis, with topline data targeted for mid-2028 and a first BLA submission planned for 2029.

catalysts.label: ZENITH AD-3 Phase 3 trial start
catalysts.detail: Third global registrational Phase 3 trial in the atopic dermatitis program, enrolling patients with prior systemic biologic and/or JAK inhibitor treatment experience, is set to initiate.

catalysts.label: Alopecia areata Phase 3 trial start
catalysts.detail: Nektar plans to initiate a single registrational Phase 3 trial of rezpegaldesleukin in severe-to-very-severe alopecia areata, based on positive Phase 2b REZOLVE-AA data (which showed continued SALT-score improvement through 52 weeks) and Fast Track designation.

catalysts.label: Q3 2026 earnings
catalysts.detail: Next quarterly financial results and pipeline update; exact report date not yet announced by the company.

catalysts.label: ZENITH AD Phase 3 topline data
catalysts.detail: Topline results from the initial ZENITH AD-1/AD-2 Phase 3 trials of rezpegaldesleukin in atopic dermatitis, the first readout of the registrational program.

catalysts.label: First BLA submission target
catalysts.detail: Company-stated target for its first Biologics License Application submission for rezpegaldesleukin in atopic dermatitis, contingent on positive Phase 3 data.

pulse: Nektar continues to trade near its 52-week highs (roughly $73-77 in the days after August 25) following a transformative summer: the global Phase 3 ZENITH AD program for rezpegaldesleukin launched in July, Q2 earnings on August 13 confirmed a fortified balance sheet ($1.02B cash, runway into Q3 2028), and full Phase 2b REZOLVE-AD data were published in The Lancet on August 25, reinforcing the Treg-biologic mechanism story. Sell-side sentiment is split but skews bullish (Canaccord and Piper Sandler at Buy with $150-185 targets versus JPMorgan's more cautious Neutral reinstatement), with the stock's roughly 7x three-year run leading some analysts to flag a rich valuation ahead of the mid-2028 pivotal AD readout, the planned early-2027 alopecia areata Phase 3 start, and a 2029 BLA target.
